reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of each exact native source, each complete unchanged raw RGB output, the complete white/cyan/alpha sheet and the unchanged naiwa mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: The smooth golden-yellow compact mascot has green-ringed black eyes and one restrained source-appropriate mouth. Sandy short temple hair and separate darker brows remain, with no invented beard, human nose, ears or skin. The tall olive peaked cap, black visor, gold trim, red-and-gold collar patches, shoulder boards and cropped neck decoration remain. The head faces screen right with the original chest-up framing and pale backing. The closed black collar meets around a short broad transition; no floating collar, long yellow stalk, clipping or cream bib is visible.
entries.alpha_decision: The original is fully opaque and the returned RGB is a complete painted rectangle. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible cutout, lost backing or clothing holes. No alpha derivation was needed or performed.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine cap emblem engraving, collar-leaf relief and individual hair strands are limited by the 156x210 source; no microscopic identity claim is made.

entries.positive_observation: Exactly one round metal monocle surrounds the screen-left eye; no second lens or full spectacles were added. Grey-brown temple hair and independent brows remain, with a smooth chin and one serious closed mouth. The rightward head direction, olive cap and uniform, red-gold collar details, shoulder boards and cropped neck decoration are retained. The compact chin meets a short broad closed-collar transition without a neck column, pinched ring, floating cloth or cream bib.
entries.alpha_decision: The original is fully opaque and the returned RGB preserves the complete pale painted background through all corners. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible transparency, holes or backing loss. No alpha derivation was needed or performed.
entries.visible_limitations: The 156x210 source does not resolve tiny cap or collar engraving, individual hair strands or a moustache; none is invented on the smooth chin.
